shots.say: Bittu opened the fridge and stared at it for a long time.
Only thirty out of every hundred people eat fruit daily.
And the share kept growing, year after year after year.
Riya laughed at him and pointed at the empty shelves.
His snack danger meter went all the way into the red.
People have cooked over fire for thirty thousand years.
So Bittu walked the long road all the way to the market.
The best mangoes in the world grow right here in India.
He came home with apples, bananas, carrots, broccoli and fish.
Riya finally smiled, because tonight dinner was his job.
